reviews.snippet:
This is easily one of the worst dining experiences I’ve had in Bangalore. I visited this restaurant today for lunch, and it was extremely disappointing from start to finish.

For a thali priced at around ₹390, the food quality is nowhere near acceptable. What you get is a very basic, average meal with nothing special to justify the high price. It feels completely overpriced for what is served.

The service is equally poor — slow, inattentive, and unprofessional. There is clearly a lack of basic customer handling.

What’s even more concerning is the hygiene. The handwash area is in a terrible state — dirty and poorly maintained to the point that it’s unpleasant to even stand there. The restroom is worse; it is so unclean that you can barely open the door.

Overall, this place fails in food quality, service, and cleanliness. I would strongly advise others to avoid this restaurant unless there is a significant improvement in standards.
